name: @aethelred/wallet-intent-router
description: EIP-712 typed intents + solver marketplace. Agents declare outcomes (transfer / swap / payment) and sign them via any @aethelred/wallet-custody-adapters backend; solvers register, quote, and settle. This is the layer that turns the wallet into an agent operating system — MoltPe is a payment rail, we're the solver marketplace above the rail.
